title: Sunday School
summary: We will read and discuss John 20
details:
John 20 tells the remarkable story of Jesus’ resurrection, beginning with Mary Magdalene discovering the empty tomb.

Jesus appears to Mary, who initially mistakes him for the gardener, and later to his disciples, offering them peace and commissioning them to continue his work.

Thomas, absent from that first appearance, refuses to believe until he sees Jesus for himself. When Jesus appears again, Thomas responds with one of the Gospel’s most powerful declarations: “My Lord and my God!” 

The chapter concludes by explaining John’s purpose in writing his Gospel: that we may believe Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and through believing have life in his name.
